#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 100000000; i += 25) {
        std::string test = std::to_string(i);
        if (test.length() != s.length()) continue;
        int xDigit = -1;
        bool ok = true;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < s.length(); ++j) {
            char sc = s[j];
            char tc = test[j];
            if (sc == 'X') {
                if (xDigit == -1) {
                    xDigit = tc;
                } else if (tc != xDigit) {
                    ok = false;
                    break;
                }
            } else if (sc != '_' && sc != tc) {
                ok = false;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (ok) ++ans;
    }
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
